text: しんぶんに　ロケットだんの　じけんが　のらない　ひは　ないな

structure.jp: ロケットだんの　じけんが　のらない　ひは
structure.en: a day when a Team Rocket incident doesn't appear

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ロケットだんの　じけんが　のらない　ひ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, describes that thing. ロケットだんの　じけんが　のらない　ひ = 'a day when a Team Rocket incident isn't printed'.

patterns.name: 〜ない〜はない
patterns.span: のらない　ひは　ない
patterns.explanation: Two 'not's cancel out: 'there is no day when it doesn't' means it happens every day. のらない　ひは　ない = 'there's no day it isn't in there'.

patterns.name: 〜な (musing)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is the speaker musing or remarking on something, like a soft 'huh' or 'you know'. ないな = 'there isn't one, huh'.
